title: Scalable partial information decomposition for symptom networks via supervised embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2609.13203v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Pairwise relationships among mental-health symptoms are routinely summarised asscalar edge weights, which cannot express whether two symptoms carry overlapping information about a third or information that appears only in combination. Partial information decomposition (PID) addresses this gap but is computationally intractable beyond a few sources.   We introduce embedding-based PID (ePID), a scalable pipeline that compresses all nonfocal symptoms into a low-cardinality discrete embedding and computes a tractable two-source PID, yielding source-unique, remainder-unique, redundant, and synergistic components for each ordered source-target pair. We benchmarked 13 candidate embeddings on synthetic Bayesian networks calibrated to PHQ-9 and on 83 real-world datasets across five PID measures. translated_title: 基于有监督嵌入的症状网络可扩展部分信息分解
translated_abstract: 心理健康症状之间的成对关系通常被概括为标量边权重，但这无法表达两个症状是否携带关于第三个症状的重叠信息，或仅在组合中才出现的信息。部分信息分解（PID）可以填补这一空白，但在源变量超过少数几个时计算上难以处理。我们提出了基于嵌入的PID（ePID），这是一个可扩展的处理流程，它将所有非焦点症状压缩为低基数的离散嵌入，并计算可处理的双源PID，为每个有序的源-目标对产生源独有、余项独有、冗余和协同四种信息分量。我们在根据PHQ-9校准的合成贝叶斯网络以及跨越五种PID测度的83个真实世界数据集上，对13个候选嵌入进行了基准测试。结果表明，在13个嵌入方法中，有监督的凝聚条件信息瓶颈（ACIB）嵌入最准确地恢复了参考分解。
tldr: 本文提出基于嵌入的可扩展部分信息分解方法ePID，利用有监督的凝聚条件信息瓶颈（ACIB）嵌入压缩非焦点症状，使症状网络的冗余与协同信息分解在83个真实数据集上变得计算可行且最准确地恢复参考分解。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces embedding-based partial information decomposition (ePID), which uses a supervised Agglomerative Conditional Information Bottleneck (ACIB) embedding to make two-source PID scalable for symptom networks, recovering reference decompositions most accurately among 13 candidate embeddings across 83 real-world datasets.
